title: Kissed Velvety Northern Thai Pepper Chicken Boat Noodles
description: A charred and velvety post-workout Northern Thai dish featuring pepper and stir-fry, macrobiotic-friendly and served as boat noodles.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add crushed northern thai pepper, onion, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add vegetable broth, fish sauce, and lime juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook rice noodles according to package instructions and drain.
Add cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken and sauce.
Serve the noodles in small boat-shaped bowls and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
